findings.summary: Artifact open-critical/open-material counters are now recomputed from findings, and READY with concealed open critical/material findings is rejected.
Remote PR head, branch head, commit existence, exact tree, origin/main ancestry, frozen-content replay and distinct pre-issued reviewer-slot binding were verified.
Traversal, symlink and resolved-containment checks are present, and request, registry, artifact and acceptance-decision schemas are validated.

Lifecycle digest normalization replaces the entire contract Status line; appending semantic authorization text to that line leaves reviewed_content_sha256 unchanged, so normalization is broader than the allowed lifecycle metadata transition.

Complete semantic locks and closed collection IDs are present, but referential closure is incomplete: a still-present EvidenceLink or Uncertainty can be detached from its Claim/revision, locks recomputed, and the validator still accepts the corrupted package.
--require-ready is restricted to the canonical package and schema and fails closed for the current REVIEW_REQUIRED candidate.
A DECIDED NARROW acceptance artifact with null frozen_commit and frozen_tree passes a REVIEWS_COMPLETE envelope; NARROW and REJECT are not required to bind the registry frozen revision as ACCEPT is.
The workflow now triggers on requirements.txt and checks out full history with fetch-depth: 0.

Source-locator tamper rejection, #330 temporal-envelope representation, atomic target uniqueness, ledger/frontier corruption tests, Claim/Evidence/Uncertainty checks, and frozen #329/#330 byte isolation otherwise passed.

commands: replay reviewed_content_sha256 from git show frozen_commit:path for every review_scope path
pip install -r requirements.txt pytest in an isolated temporary venv
controlled orphan EvidenceLink and Uncertainty tests with recomputed ledger/package locks
controlled lifecycle Status-line semantic-tamper digest test
controlled REVIEWS_COMPLETE plus unbound DECIDED NARROW test
conclusion: The frozen identity and most round-1 remediations verify correctly, and all 35 focused tests pass. Three material fail-open gaps remain in digest normalization, EvidenceLink/Uncertainty referential closure, and NARROW/REJECT frozen-revision binding; the candidate is therefore not READY.
